definitions.gloss: to carry back; to return to a previous state
definitions.explanation: To move something back to its original position or state. Used both literally (rewinding tape) and figuratively (reverting financial losses or recovering past payments).

examples.japanese: テープを{繰|く}り{戻|もど}した。
{時間|じかん}を{繰|く}り{戻|もど}すことはできない。
{赤字|あかじ}を{前年|ぜんねん}の{利益|りえき}に{繰|く}り{戻|もど}して{税金|ぜいきん}の{還付|かんぷ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received a tax refund by carrying back the deficit against the previous year's profits.

notes:
USAGE:
Has both everyday and specialized financial meanings. In tax and accounting contexts, {繰|く}り{戻|もど}す refers to carrying back losses to offset previous years' profits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {損失|そんしつ}を{繰|く}り{戻|もど}す (to carry back a loss)
- {時間|じかん}を{繰|く}り{戻|もど}す (to turn back time)
- {繰戻還付|くりもどしかんぷ} (loss carryback refund)

CONTRAST:
- {繰|く}り{越|こ}す: to carry forward (to future periods)
